title: Reproduce the Durable Registry Git commit identity mismatch

phases.objective: Prove that the schema-verification v2 evidence is schema-compatible with the Durable Registry while the Registry still rejects the repository's 40-character Git object identity.

e2e_journeys.actor: Spec 014 Durable Authorized Injection Registry constructor
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A secret-free successful schema-verification object using the current 40-character Integration commit SHA
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact consumer failure is reproduced before any database connection opens, while a 64-character control identity is accepted and the repair remains explicitly unperformed.
steps: Build exact Durable Injection schema evidence with the canonical contract key, digest, and two-table set.
Pass the current 40-character Integration Git commit as source_commit and deployed_runtime_sha.
Assert the Registry rejects source_commit with STORAGE_DURABLE_INJECTION_HASH_INVALID.
Pass a 64-character control identity and assert the canonical Registry is constructed without database access.
Record that the producer accepts 40 or 64 characters while the consumer currently accepts only 64.
Keep runtime repair, authorization, migration execution, provider dispatch, deployment, and Production false.
assertions: The schema contract binding succeeds before commit identity validation.
No SQL connection is opened by the constructor-only inspection.
The existing durable_registry_binding_ready claim is scoped to schema evidence only.
Durable Registry runtime acceptance remains false until a commit-specific validator accepts 40 or 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

phases.objective: Replace commit fields' SHA-256 validator with an exact Git object identity validator without weakening digest validation.
Reject malformed, mixed-length, uppercase, or parity-mismatched commit identities after the repair.
No live canary is appropriate for a repository-only mismatch reproduction.
This blocker proof grants no deployment, main, or Production authority.
